simple.meaning: אַגָּף (ʼaggâph) is a Hebrew object word meaning “(only plural) wings of an army , or crowds of troops.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezekiel 12:14. The surrounding context includes blood, land, mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַגָּף (H102) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: אַגָּף (ʼaggâph) / H102 is traced through Ezekiel 12:14, Ezekiel 17:21, Ezekiel 38:6, Ezekiel 38:9 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: (only plural) wings of an army , or crowds of troops
definitions.full: H102. agaph [ אֲגַף ] noun [masculine] band, army (loan-word, originally wing of army; Assyrian agappu , Aramaic אגף , wing . Others, from גפ֩ף , Sta § 256 b ) — All Ezekiel & all plural (or dual ?) אֲגַמֶּיךָ Ezek 38:9 ; 39:4 ; אֲגַמָּיו 12:14 3 t; אֲגַמֶּיהָ 38:6 (all with כָּלֿ except 38:22 ) — bands, armies of king of Judah 12:14 ; 17:21 ; hordes (RV) of Gog 38:9 , 22 ; 39:4 ; specifically of גֹּמֶר 38:6 ; of תּוֺגַרְמָה ib.
definitions.rootNote: probably from 5062 (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e.

occurrences.englishText: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’
Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many peoples with you.
Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many peoples with you.
You will ascend. You will come like a storm. You will be like a cloud to cover the land, you, and all your hordes, and many peoples with you.”

I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, and on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, an overflowing shower, with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.

You will fall on the mountains of Israel, you, and all your hordes, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the animals of the field to be devoured.
